 This is a combined synopsis/solicitation for commercial items prepared in accordance with the format in FAR Part 12. This announcement constitutes the only solicitation. Quotations are being requested and a separate written solicitation will not be issued. 
Solicitation number 124PCA27Q0006 is issued as a Request for Quotation (RFQ). 

 United States Department of Agriculture (USDA), Agricultural Research Service (ARS), Livestock Arthropod Pest Research Unit in Kerrville, TX has a construction requirement for replacement of a cattle dip vat and drip pad. See attached scope documents for a complete list of requirements.    

  
This acquisition is set-aside for small business concerns. The applicable North American Industry Classification Standard Code is 236220 The small business size standard is $45M This acquisition is a Total Small Business Set-Aside. All responsible sources may submit a quotation which will be considered by the agency.
